text:
Reviewed 1,510 LOC. Existing pytest suite passes: `58 passed`. `py_compile` succeeds when writing bytecode to `/tmp`; Ruff/mypy are not installed; `git` is not installed here.

**Score: 6/10.** The code is readable and has decent fixture-based coverage, but I would not approve it as-is. The biggest problem is data correctness across repeated ingests: removed inputs leave stale rows/aliases behind, so reports can be wrong while summaries look correct. There are also malformed-input crashes despite the stated “warnings, not crashes” behavior.

| Severity | File | Lines | Issue |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| high | `evalmerge/ingest.py` | 73-89 | Re-ingesting changed inputs only upserts current records, so rows removed from source files remain in `results`. |
| high | `evalmerge/normalize.py` | 83-95 | `nan` scores parse as floats, bypass clamping, and crash SQLite with `NOT NULL constraint failed`. |
| high | `evalmerge/parsers.py` | 203-205 | Format B crashes on truthy non-dict `metrics` values instead of recording `malformed_row`. |
| high | `evalmerge/parsers.py` | 254 | Malformed XML raises `ParseError` and aborts ingest instead of returning a structured warning. |
| medium | `evalmerge/cli.py` | 44-47 | Empty-directory ingest creates/mutates the database before returning “no input files found”. |
| medium | `evalmerge/db.py` | 70-74 | `model_aliases` is append-only, so stale raw model spellings remain after inputs are corrected or removed. |
| medium | `evalmerge/parsers.py` | 110-158, 202-239, 256-318 | Required canonical fields like `run_id`, `model`, and `task` can be empty and still inserted. |
| medium | `evalmerge/parsers.py` | 281-300 | Format C emits non-fatal `unknown_unit` warnings before timestamp validation, so skipped rows can be reported as kept/assumed. |
| low | `evalmerge/parsers.py` | 87, 173 | CSV/JSONL inputs are read fully into memory instead of streamed, limiting scalability on large harness outputs. |
| low | `tests/test_pipeline.py` | 194-211 | Idempotency tests only re-ingest identical fixtures and miss changed-input stale-row regressions. |

Estimated rewrite/significant-change scope: **180 lines** including production fixes and missing regression tests.

Bottom line: **No, I would not approve this PR as-is.**
